sentences.en: Skin color is related to the newborn's ability to oxygenate its body and extremities and is dependent on heart rate and respirations.

sentences.en: In addition a good decanting funnel should also oxygenate your wine.
sentences.vi: Ngoài ra, một phễu chiết tốt cũng nên cung cấp oxy cho rượu của bạn.

sentences.en: This impaired ability to fully oxygenate the extremities is due to an immature circulatory system which is still in flux.

sentences.en: Fish tanks often have a pump which oxygenates the water.

sentences.en: In such arteriovenous malformations, much of the oxygenated arterial blood is shunted directly into the veins without ever traversing the capillaries.
sentences.vi: Trong những dị dạng động mạch như vậy, phần lớn máu động mạch được cung cấp oxy sẽ chuyển thẳng vào tĩnh mạch mà không bao giờ đi qua mao mạch.

sentences.en: An excellent oxygenating plant, but apt to get out of control in large or natural ponds.
